note: Rewritten from the original description by Silvestri (1914) (published as Cubitermes severus and later placed in Isognathotermes); the original is in Latin; the queen, soldier and worker are described; the same work also describes var. modestior, which is not included in this entry; measurements are given in mm as in the original.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen: body length 22 mm, abdominal width 4.5 mm; head length 1.46 mm, width 1.36 mm; major diameter of the compound eye 0.45 mm; hind tibia 2.08 mm. Head and thorax chestnut to almost black; clypeus chestnut; pronotum chestnut to almost black, mesonotum and metanotum chestnut; underside of the legs pale red; abdomen milky white, pleurites with red spots, tergites chestnut, sternites mostly ochraceous in the middle. Compound eyes rather large and prominent; distance between ocellus and compound eye less than the major diameter of the ocellus; frontal region slightly concave at the ocellus; fontanelle small, the surrounding frontal region of similar colour; clypeus slightly inflated. Antennal segment 2 subequal in length to 3 and 4, segments 3 and 4 subequal, segment 5 slightly longer than 4. Posterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave in the middle; that of the mesonotum deeply concave and broadly angular in the middle, with acute posterior corners; the concavity of the metanotal posterior margin shallower than that of the mesonotum, with subcircular posterior corners.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 9.5 mm; head length 3 mm, width 2.1 mm; mandible length 2.2 mm; hind tibia 1.75 mm. Body pale ochraceous, head ochraceous to rusty, mandibles almost black, abdomen with grey patches from the gut contents. Head about 1/4 longer than wide, well convex, anteriorly convex-rounded above the gland opening, the sides slightly narrowed posteriorly. Labrum sub-trapezoidal, its anterior margin deeply and widely concave, the anterior corners broadly triangular. Mandibles less than 1/4 shorter than the head capsule, rather straight, only the tips slightly curved. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 2 twice as long as 3; segment 4 slightly longer than 3; segment 5 about 1/6 longer than 4. Posterior margin of the anterior lobe of the pronotum slightly concave in the middle. Fore coxae with 2—3 very short spines on the outer side, trochanters with 2—3 very short spines, the inner margin of the tibia with 4—5 short spines in addition to the usual apical spur.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body length 6.5 mm; head width 1.56 mm; hind tibia 1.43 mm. Body straw-coloured, head pale yellowish white, clypeus well inflated. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 ring-like, barely distinguishable from 4, bare; segment 5 slightly longer than 4. Posterior margin of the anterior lobe of the pronotum not concave in the middle. Fore coxae with 3 stout spines on the outer side, trochanters with 5—6, the inner margin of the tibia with 9—6 spines (in addition to the usual apical spur); the inner margin of the mid tibia with 5—6 spines, and 2 slightly stouter spines on the outer side near the apex plus the usual inner spur.
